paired_interval_method: Descriptive percentile bootstrap of paired-round median savings: 10000 resamples, seed 10448, indexes 249 and 9749. Resampling does not establish stationarity or remove host/device interference.
scope: Offline batch-one CUDA graphs, FP8 DiT linears, BF16 FA3/CE, VAE parallel enabled. No production default changed.
baseline_note: Whole serial owns its output; equal and unequal two-group variants borrow graph-scoped outputs. Versus equal isolates partition selection; versus serial includes the existing output-ownership/schedule improvements.
communication_budget_source: evidence/core-budget-summary.json; isolated control timings from the earlier budget run

acceptance.h3-4k-4+10: Validated improvement over 7+7 in this offline fixed-canvas experiment: 30/30 paired wins. No default service claim.
acceptance.h3-3k-even-groups: Not selected: both even alternatives lose to 7+7 in all eight screening rounds.
acceptance.wan-4+8: Additional E2E improvement over 6+6 is not established: paired intervals include zero in both 30-round confirmations. Large within-stage timing variance prevents accepting the apparent 14.74% ratio-of-medians gain over whole in the higher-resolution case.
